Internal helper: the one variable a single-variable slot names

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_one_var_name.Rd

jrecode(), jrelabel() and jencode() take ONE variable, and read it with deparse(substitute()), so a name in quotes was refused as not found: '"Gender" was not found', where the thirteen other slots took it (ruling R18, Session 355; built Session 356). This reads the slot as the lists do: a bare name, a quoted name, or a c() of one; a c() of several stops, naming them, since the function takes one. Anything else is deparsed as before and meets the not-found check.

Usage

.jst_one_var_name(sub, fn, slot = "after the data frame")

Arguments

sub

The slot as typed (substitute()), or a quosure.

fn

Character(1); the user-facing function's name.

slot

Character(1); how the sentence names the slot: "after the data frame" (the default), or "by =".

Value

Character(1), the name.
